title: Visual styles
brief: Relay's default classic islands layout in different visual languages: DBFlux's Bolt Byzantium for reference, and three style languages on the Copper palette (shape, type, tabs, controls, density), not just colors.

artboards.title: Bolt Byzantium (DBFlux)
artboards.tradeoff: Proven, distinctive cut-corner system; it is DBFlux's identity, so Relay would read as a sibling product

artboards.title: Copper / Machined
artboards.tradeoff: Instrument-like and precise; chamfers and segmented controls cost more to build in GPUI

artboards.title: Copper / Soft
artboards.tradeoff: Calm and approachable; lowest density, fewer rows on screen

artboards.title: Copper / Terminal
artboards.tradeoff: Densest and most keyboard-native; mono chrome is harder to scan for non-technical users
